# Pulse 1.0.393 🚀

## 🏠 Home screen icons
- 🎨 Every extra app and Pulse itself have real launcher icons in the line look and in six Material glass colours: blue, purple, pink, cyan, green and amber.
- 🧭 The icon chooser has a Home screen icon section: pick Line or a colour and tap Apply to the home screen.
- 📱 A tablet starts with blue glass icons, a phone with the line icons. The look of each app can be changed on its own.

## 🎮 Game Hub
- 🎲 Mix: boxes are dealt across Steam, PS5, Switch and Xbox Series; each game's spine says its box's console.
- 🎨 A console box's spine and back take that console's colours.
- 💿 Hold the open box to eject the disc, drag it onto the console to start the game; let go elsewhere and it goes back in.
- 🔙 Returning from a game shows the shelf again.

## 🤖 Pulse AI
- 🧠 Five more small uncensored chat models.
- 👁️ A Vision section in the Models tab, with two uncensored vision models.

## 📊 Excel
- 📄 Excel 2003 XML files, also named .xls or .xlsx, open with their sheets, rows and cells.

## 🆕 What's new
- 🗒️ The update notes show this version's changes.
